THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
KNITWEAR & LAYERS
104
STUDY 089
Gray Cardigan & Polka Dot Skirt
Rights check
Source: 24965.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with dark hair pulled back at
the nape stands in a full-length pose. She wears a fitted
gray cardigan with a fitted peplum hem over a pale blue
blouse with a ruffled collar and a tied bow at the neck. A
pale blue A-line midi skirt with small black dots, a black
crossbody bag, and gray knee socks with black buckled
loafers complete the look. Her expression is calm and
composed. Soft, warm studio light against a beige wall.
Palette of gray, powder blue, and black. Soft and
polished, in the style of a preppy spring catalog.
Soft, polished, classic
WORKING NOTES
- The bow collar and polka dot skirt are the signature
details.
- Keep the beige wall for a soft, neutral backdrop.
